Product ID: DEMO-LLM-002
Product Name: Everyday Hydrating Cream
SKU: DEMOLLM02

Description:
A synthetic demo product for exercising tier 6 (LLM reasoning) against the
REAL default forbidden list -- no custom list swap needed. Its only
forbidden-adjacent ingredient is the ester/IUPAC-style name for a real
forbidden entry (Butylparaben), which tiers 1-4 cannot resolve on their own
(confirmed empirically: rapidfuzz ratio/token_sort/token_set/WRatio all score
"Butylparaben" vs "Butyl 4-hydroxybenzoate" well under the production fuzzy
threshold). Not part of the provided sample dataset -- used by
test_routes_evaluate_llm.py and the Loom demo script in docs/LOOM_NOTES.md.

Ingredients / Chemical Formulas:
- Aqua
- Glycerin
- Butyl 4-hydroxybenzoate
